answer_1.quote: We propose a comprehensive benchmark, NLEBench, specifically tailored to evaluate the natural language generation capabilities in Norwegian... We primarily explored two tasks using the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) method: ... let the model answer the annotated questions, and then let the model generate a summary of the article.
answer_1.outputs: generated responses, abstractive summaries, instruction-following texts, QA answers

answer_2.quote: We aim to comprehensively evaluate our models across various tasks using widely used metrics for NLP tasks, including BLEU, ROUGE, Distinct, and MAUVE, ... we utilize Entailment scores from a fine-tuned NorBERT model ... Toxicity scores were obtained using the Perspective API.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation on three datasets translated by the Google API... We recruited three Norwegian native speakers, all of whom are college students, to independently score the Adequacy and Fluency of each text.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored each text on a 1‑5 scale for Adequacy (meaning preservation) and Fluency (naturalness in Norwegian).
